The '''Nightsister energy lance''' was a rare polearm weapon used by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], who wielded it with skill that could disarm or entangle opponents. [[Axkva Min]] was known to use such weapon. The energy lance held an electrical charge located within the core of the lance, which caused great damage to opponents hit with it.

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightsister energy lance appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
